description: Rolling-window baseline for BenchmarkSuite's 6-metric learning-evidence schema (issue #286). Small fixed CI network -- not production scale. History entries accumulate via --update-baseline; see scripts/learning_evidence_ci_gate.py. concept_separability sits at a reproducible 0.0 floor at this CI scale (100-neuron concept layer, 4 patterns, few reps has too little capacity/training to separate classes) -- not a bug; regression on it means it went negative, i.e. worse than random. benchmark_args.seed (pattern/fixture generation) and network_seed (weight-init, issue #322's two-seeds distinction) are both fixed so the actual gate run is fully deterministic -- no flakiness from OS-entropy weight init. The 3 history entries below instead vary network_seed only, capturing the genuine spread across different (but equally valid) initializations so the threshold reflects real acceptable variance rather than one arbitrary snapshot.
